about: The glyph table for Icon — one SVG path `d` per glyph on a 16x16 grid, the single source every platform draws from.
Line glyphs stroke in the text color at `border.width.focus` with round caps and joins; `filled` glyphs fill with
fill-rule evenodd and draw no stroke (the status shapes' inner mark is a hole, so they read on any surface).
tools/icon-snapshots.ts (renders tests/icon-snapshots/*.png with Playwright). The JS packages still carry their
own copies (packages/react/src/Icon.tsx, packages/lit/src/Icon.ts, packages/rn/src/paths.ts) and read this file
in their next regeneration — see prompts/conventions/*.md.
The names are exactly the Icon doc's `name` enum, in its order; tools/icon-paths.ts fails if they drift.
Only M, L, H, V, C, Q, A, Z (absolute and relative) may appear: that is what Support/SVGPath.swift parses.

ellipsis.note: three dots, the web table's three r=1.25 circles as one path

list.note: the bullet dots are zero-length round-capped strokes, so the whole glyph is one stroked path
